verdict.rationale: Better Stack ships an AI SRE agent, so connecting external MCP servers to it is a fair question. However, the evidence only describes Better Stack's own MCP server, which exposes its telemetry to other LLM tools such as Claude Code and Claude Desktop. That is the server role and does not show Better Stack consuming tools from user-supplied MCP servers. No evidence shows MCP client or plug-in support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
